DesignLead: quick thread 1) should we add a compact toggle for the left rail (icons-only) alongside the regrouping? 2) how will deep links behave when the nav collapses? ProductPM: compact mode is useful for power users and small screens. we need clear affordance for pinned sections. deep link behavior must land users in the correct content regardless of nav state. FrontendEng: implementation idea: two global states: `navLayout=expanded|compact` in local storage + optional query param `?nav=compact` for shareable links. deep links ignore layout and route directly to content. when arriving with `?nav=compact` we set layout after route hydrate. EngRouter: routing concern: query params collide with other tracking params. prefer hash fragments for client-only state: `/#/workspaces/123/models?nav=compact` vs `/#nav=compact` ambiguous. also recommend canonical URLs without UI state for canonicalization. DesignLead: agree canonical URLs should be clean. but we still need a way to share a specific view + compact view for screenshots. maybe use a separate `?ui=compact` that we strip server-side for canonical analytics. Accessibility: compact is OK if tooltip labels are consistent and focus target order doesn't change. must ensure icon-only buttons have aria-labels and visible focus outlines. UXResearch: note from last session: icon-only nav increases task time for new users. recommend an onboarding hint that shows names briefly on first use and an easy 'expand' CTA. FrontendEng: small code sketch for aria/tooltip: ```
Models
``` Also will emit analytics: `nav_action: toggle_compact` with user id and source. ProductPM: analytics rule: don't log nav layout for >90 days to protect privacy; but count toggles to detect confusion. DevExBot: ticket RDW-1987 created to track compact toggle + share param cleanup. EngRouter: another routing pattern proposal: use path segments for cluster context instead of query strings: `/workspaces/123/cluster/deployments` vs `/workspaces/123/deployments` 1) pros: explicit cluster context in breadcrumbs. cons: longer URLs. DesignLead: I like explicit cluster in path because breadcrumbs become natural. but we should provide a redirect layer such that both `/workspaces/123/deployments` and `/workspaces/123/cluster/deployments` resolve. DevExBot: added subtask RDW-1987a for route aliases. Accessibility: keyboard shortcut idea: `g` then `d` to jump to Deployments, `g` then `m` for Models. make sure shortcuts do not conflict with input fields and are discoverable via a help modal. UXResearch: will run a quick remote unmoderated test with keyboard users to validate the two-step shortcut flows. FrontendEng: will prototype compact/expanded toggle, tooltip behavior, and keyboard shortcuts in a playground branch. aim to demo Thursday. DesignLead: next steps: prototype + UX test + routing alias plan. we'll pick clear microcopy: use "Deployments" and "Models & Catalog" as labels. thanks everyone. :rocket:
